name: Camp Ta-Kum-Ta
description_short: A year-round camp in South Hero for children ages 7 to 17 who have or have had cancer and live in or are treated in Vermont (some programs also serve Northern New York). The main program is a one-week overnight summer camp (Sunday to Saturday); there are also winter weekends by age group, a siblings weekend and a camper exchange.
special_needs_notes: For children ages 7-17 who have or have had cancer. Medical staff, many of them the same people who treat campers at the hospital, are at camp 24/7, and camp is about 15 minutes from UVM Medical Center. The FAQ says camp is free for children treated at UVM Medical Center and their families, including transportation from the hospital to summer camp, food, medical care and activities.

sessions.name: Camper Exchange with Rapahope in Mobile, AL (age 17+, recent graduates)

sources.note: Summer program description (event page from 2019; activity list only)

warnings: The page only lists 2026 dates. Today is 2026-10-13, so the 2026 summer camp and most other programs have already happened. Only the Halloween Party (Oct 17, 2026) and Holiday Party (Dec 5, 2026) are still upcoming. No 2027 dates are posted.

Eligibility is restricted to children who have or have had cancer and live or are treated in Vermont, or in some programs live in Northern New York. The siblings, parent and family programs have their own eligibility rules.
Not listed as sessions: the adult-only MOMs Weekend (Apr 10-12, 2026), Dads Weekend (Sep 25-27, 2026), Family Fun Day (May 31, 2026) and the under-7 Playgroups (Jan 10, Mar 28, May 16, Aug 15, 2026).

Ages in the sessions are taken from each program's eligibility. The Exchange Program also requires campers to have graduated from Camp Ta-Kum-Ta within the past year. The Young Adult Weekend uses a separate application link.
